title: Residue push mate normalized to the right-adjoint projection map
statement: Use [def-weil-pbc-residue-exchange-comparison-interface]. Assume, for every scheme T, the stated left-derived tensor universal property for integralReduction followed by exact scalar restriction. Put B_T equal to the restricted residue regular module in degree zero. There exists a coherent family c of pull comparisons. For each morphism f:X→Y there is a strong monoidal structure m on the actual integral derived pullback. For each integral complex K on X there are isomorphisms s from restricted reduction of Rf_*K to Rf_*K tensor B_Y and e from restricted reduction of K to K tensor f^*B_Y. The restriction of (c.push f).app K, followed by the proved c.restrictPushIso at reduction of K and Rf_* applied to e.hom, equals s.hom followed by the right-adjoint projection map at K and B_Y, formed from the actual integral derived adjunction and the oplax tensor structure of m. No perfectness, dualizability, boundedness, properness, or invertibility of this projection map is assumed or concluded.

source.place: Lemma 6.5.9(3), Proposition 6.8.11(3), Remark 6.8.15; explicit formal coefficient and adjunction argument

proof.text: Construct the canonical coherent scalar pull comparisons as inverse mates of exact restriction/pullback; their invertibility and composition property assemble c.
Use the canonical tensor-square assembly to obtain the actual derived monoidal structure and both tensor presentations, including the coefficient-pullback identification.

The private doubleMate lemma derives the conjugated right-adjoint counit identity from the scalar-counit identity. The private normalization lemma transposes the desired map equality under the integral adjunction, then uses naturality, the mates counit identity, and the tensor-square equation. The remaining transpose is exactly the defining counit identity for rightAdjointProjectionMap. The normalization_family helper packages these identities, and the final theorem specializes it to the actual four adjunctions. No invertibility of a projection map is asserted or used.

proof_origin.note: D3 proves the generic double-mate and projection-normalization calculation and specializes it to canonical pull and tensor data. Canonical tensor presentation and ordinary/derived monoidal APIs are constructed with proofs. Only the strictly geometric pull-square property and fixed tensor-square compatibility remain as two named obligations; this is a decomposition, not an axiom-free closure.

lean.statement:
theorem integralResidue_projection_normalization
    (hTensor : ∀ T : Scheme.{u},
      ∃ ε : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ (integralReduction ℓ E T ⋙
            (Mod.comap (coefficientMap (integralReductionMap ℓ E) T)).mapDerivedCategory) ⟶
          Functor.mapHomotopyCategory
            (MonoidalCategory.tensorLeft
            ((Mod.comap (coefficientMap (integralReductionMap ℓ E) T)).obj
              (Mod.regular (condensedRingObj
                (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (integralResidue ℓ E)) T)))) (.up ℤ) ⋙
            DerivedCategory.Qh,
        Functor.IsLeftDerivedFunctor
          (integralReduction ℓ E T ⋙
            (Mod.comap (coefficientMap (integralReductionMap ℓ E) T)).mapDerivedCategory)
          ε (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
            (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) Ab.{u + 1})
              (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) T)) (.up ℤ))) :
    ∃ c : IntegralResiduePullComparisons.{u} ℓ E,
      ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y),
        ∃ m : (residueExchangeUpperStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) f).Monoidal,
          letI := m
          ∀ K : residueExchangeDerived (integralCoeff ℓ E) X,
            ∃ (s :
                (Mod.comap (coefficientMap (integralReductionMap ℓ E) Y)).mapDerivedCategory.obj
                    ((residueExchangeReduction ℓ E Y).obj
                      ((residueExchangeLowerStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) f).obj K)) ≅
                  (residueExchangeLowerStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) f).obj K ⊗
                    residueExchangeCoefficient ℓ E Y)
              (e :
                (Mod.comap (coefficientMap (integralReductionMap ℓ E) X)).mapDerivedCategory.obj
                    ((residueExchangeReduction ℓ E X).obj K) ≅
                  K ⊗ (residueExchangeUpperStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) f).obj
                    (residueExchangeCoefficient ℓ E Y)),
              (Mod.comap (coefficientMap (integralReductionMap ℓ E) Y)).mapDerivedCategory.map
                  ((c.push f).app K) ≫
                (c.restrictPushIso f).hom.app ((residueExchangeReduction ℓ E X).obj K) ≫
                (residueExchangeLowerStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) f).map e.hom =
                s.hom ≫
                  (((residueExchangeAdjunction (integralCoeff ℓ E) f).rightAdjointProjectionMap
                    (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δNatTrans
                      (residueExchangeUpperStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) f))).app K).app
                    (residueExchangeCoefficient ℓ E Y)
